text_en: manager of the Rest Stop of Final Results

text: Karikatura u izmišljenom svijetu. Sve što govori je originalna satira, ne stvarne izjave; glas, ako ga ima, je sintetiziran.
text_en: A caricature in an invented world. Everything he says is original satire, not real statements; his voice, if any, is synthesized.

text: Most je spreman za drugu fazu.
text_en: The bridge is ready for phase two.
The banner is standing down there.

text: Drvena govornica s mikrofonom bez kabla. Jedan govor po spustu: više izdržljivosti na kratko, ali vas se i više čuje.
text_en: A wooden podium with a cordless microphone. One speech per descent: more stamina for a while, but you can be heard further too.

text: Govor je već održan na ovom spustu.
text_en: The speech has already been given on this descent.

text: Ne radi. Na naljepnici piše da radi.
text_en: Out of order. The sticker says it works.

text: Prečac preko mosta još ne postoji na stazi. Kad ga staza dobije, ovo je ključ za njega.
text_en: The shortcut over the bridge isn't on the route yet. When the route gets it, this is the key to it.
The automaton worker sets off for the bridge. ({count}/{total})

text: Ovdje ide transparent. Odozgo se ne vidi.
text_en: The banner goes here. It can't be seen from above.

text: Nađi tri zapisnika niz stazu i vrati ih predsjedniku na sljedećem odmorištu.
text_en: Find three records down the route and bring them back to the president at the next rest stop.

text: Pošalji dva radnika-automata na most ili donesi četiri jedinice materijala.
text_en: Send two automaton workers to the bridge or bring four units of material.

text: Nosi transparent (12 kg) do tribine {drop} m niže. Ne daj da padne.
text_en: Carry the banner (12 kg) to the grandstand {drop} m further down. Don't let it fall.
Done: go back to the president

text: Vjetar je odnio zapisnik. Oštećena kopija čeka na sljedećem odmorištu.
text_en: The wind took a record. A damaged copy waits at the next rest stop.

text: Transparent (12 kg) ne stane u ruksak. Napravi mjesta pa pitaj ponovo.
text_en: The banner (12 kg) doesn't fit in your pack. Make room and ask again.

text: Privremeni mandat: vraćen si s četvrtinom zdravlja. Jednom po spustu.
text_en: Temporary mandate: you're back with a quarter of your health. Once per descent.

text: Govor održan: +10% izdržljivosti na minutu, ali te se i bolje čuje.
text_en: Speech given: +10% stamina for a minute, but you can be heard better too.

text: Odmor: za spavanje je prerano. Ležaj je pod nadstrešnicom kad padne mrak.
text_en: Rest: it's too early to sleep. The bed is under the shelter when it gets dark.

text: Megafon! Sve u blizini je na trenutak zbunjeno.
text_en: Megaphone! Everything nearby is confused for a moment.
The megaphone is still cooling down.

text: Mapa optimizma: do sljedeće stanice samo {short} m. (Ostali izvori kažu {real} m.)
text_en: Map of optimism: only {short} m to the next station. (Other sources say {real} m.)
